modern: Consider the past—such great changes of political power; you may foresee also the things which will be. For they will certainly be of the same form, and it is not possible that they should stray from the order of the things which happen now; accordingly, to have contemplated human life for forty years is the same as to have contemplated it for ten thousand years. For what more will you see?
original: Consider the past,—such great changes of political supremacies; thou mayest foresee also the things which will be. For they will certainly be of like form, and it is not possible that they should deviate from the order of the things which take place now; accordingly to have contemplated human life for forty years is the same as to have contemplated it for ten thousand years. For what more wilt thou see?
